messages:
sarah-sales: Hey team — POC with a regulated fintech customer hit two blockers during the Azure gov trial. Need quick swarm to unblock before EOD.
maria-se: TL;DR: customer pinned model to `mistral-13b-v0` in their private VNet in `azure-gov-west-1`. Requests return either `model_not_available_in_region` or 429s depending on route.
amir-rt: Sending logs now. 429s look like: 
```
2026-03-20T15:02:11Z ERROR request_id=abcd1234 status=429 reason=rate_limit scope=region:azure-gov-west-1 model=mistral-13b-v0
2026-03-20T15:02:12Z ERROR request_id=abcd1235 status=410 reason=model_deprecated model=mistral-13b-v0 variant=hf
```
lee-eng: Confirmed: the `mistral-13b-v0` HF wheel was deprecated in that region last month — we failed to surface deprecation via admin UI for private VNet customers. That's on us. :grimacing:
sarah-sales: Customer concerned about compliance — they cannot accept routing to public hosted models. They want either 1) compatible variant in the same region or 2) a clear migration plan + cost for Dedicated/reserved capacity. Maria, they also asked about impact to the security questionnaire (KMS + VNet).maria-se: For KMS: private deployments support customer-managed keys (HSM) but Azure gov KMS integration requires an extra config we need to enable on their tenant (I have the checklist). For VNet: need to confirm egress rules; if we route to fallback model in another region we must document cross-region controls.
eva-ps: Quick workaround: suggest they pin to `mistral-13b-v0-quant` or `mistral-13b-compatible-2026-03` (a compat build we keep in gov regions) — but need to verify evals. Can we approve that as an official fallback?
amir-rt: I tested `mistral-13b-quant` in a sandbox in azure-gov-west-1 — model loads but token perf differs. Sample API call we used:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "mistral-13b-quant",
  "input": "Summarize invoice #1234",
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```
Response: 200 but 3x latency vs hosted eu-west due to quant kernel path. No 429s in my load test (50 rps sustained for 2m).
lee-eng: Ops note: the 429 was coming from our region quota enforcement because the pinned HF variant was still routing to a retired runtime. I've queued a fix to route deprecated pins automatically to the compat build when available. Will need approval for auto-fallback for private VNet customers.
sarah-sales: Customer asks about pricing delta if we switch them to Dedicated (reserved) vs use the compat build in their region. Can finance give a ballpark?
maria-se: Rough numbers: compat build in-region = same hosted token pricing + small integration fee. Dedicated reserved (1x A100-equivalent pool) = baseline monthly commit ~ $60k/mo for guaranteed throughput (depends on burst). I'll ping finance for precise quote.
deploy-bot: [deployment-notice] 2026-03-20T15:20:00Z Canary routing update queued: route deprecated pins -> compat variants (pending approval from eng oncall).
amir-rt: Approve automatic compat fallback for this POC only (opt-in). We should add telemetry flag so we can audit traffic and revert if anything funky.
lee-eng: Agreed. I'll add opt-in via customer config `pin_fallback: enable`. Also will push a one-off policy to avoid cross-region routing for private VNet unless explicitly allowed.
sarah-sales: OK — next steps I need from the swarm by 18:00 PST: 1) confirm compat build availability for azure-gov-west-1 (amir) 2) written note for customer on KMS + VNet implications (maria) 3) provisional pricing delta (maria + finance) 4) opt-in fallback enabled with telemetry (lee)
maria-se: I have the KMS checklist and will paste the snippet for Azure gov integration: 
```
- Enable customer-managed key in Azure Key Vault (gov tier)
- Provide service principal with Key Encryption Key unwrap permissions to Redwood-SA
- Configure private endpoint for vault and our control plane
```
maria-se: Also adding a short blurb for SOC/security: "No plaintext model artifacts leave customer's VNet when compat fallback is enabled — runtime executes in customer's private pool or approved gov variant." (we should verify this technically before sending)
amir-rt: Confirmed compat variant image exists and artifacts are in gov region repo. Can enable now for POC. No decryption outside VNet. I ran a small eval, quality looks within acceptable bounds for the demo.
sarah-sales: Customer also asked about SLA for Dedicated if they convert after POC. We should include link to Dedicated SLA and a note about lead time for reserved capacity.
eva-ps: I'll assemble a one-pager for the customer covering: fallback plan, KMS checklist, pricing ballpark, and required approvals. ETA 17:30 PST.
lee-eng: Implemented opt-in flag in staging. Config key: `pin_fallback: { "mode": "compat-only", "audit": true }` — will schedule a PR for prod after security signoff.
sarah-sales: Thanks all. If we can get the compat build enabled and the one-pager, I'll send to customer and ask them to enable `pin_fallback` in their onboarding YAML. :pray:
maria-se: Sending the KMS checklist + pricing stub to you privately now.
